hooks.command: jq -r '[(.tool_input.file_path? // empty), (.tool_response | objects | .filePath // empty), (.tool_input.files[]?.path // empty)] | .[]' | while read -r f; do root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$f" in /*) ;; *) f="$root/$f" ;; esac; case "$f" in "$root"/*) "$root/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; done; true
